newsitem.title: USA: Wellpoint acquisition delayed by lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Wellpoint acquisition delayed by lawsuit.

text.p: WellPoint Health Networks Inc said Monday the planned acquisition of the group health and related businesses of John Hancock Mutual Life Insurance Co did not close on January 31 as had been expected.

The company said SelectCare Inc, a Detroit network manager of doctors and hospitals, won a preliminary injunction after filing a suit January 28 claiming the deal would violate certain agreements between SelectCare and John Hancock.
Wellpoint said it and John Hancock have agreed to extend their agreement until March 1 to evaluate the order and to try to complete their deal in a way that complies with the court order.
Under the extension, either party may terminate the agreement at any time during the extension period, the company said.
